_what: How late a recurring run may be and still count as its own time (src/schedule-lateness.mjs, read by src/automations.mjs when a schedule's run starts). The grace is `grace_fraction` of the schedule's period, never under `grace_min_seconds` and never over `grace_max_seconds`, so a daily schedule still counts a run after a long outage as late while a schedule every few minutes does not. A run within `on_time_seconds` of its time is on time (ticker slack, not downtime); within the grace it is late; beyond it, it is a catch-up: the run still happens once, and the times missed in between are not replayed. The class is kept on the schedule's last_run, so a missed stretch is said, not silent.
